item.title: Rep. Riley Moore says Nixon was framed by deep state
item.description: Rep. Riley Moore gave a revisionist account of Watergate at the Nixon Foundation, saying the president was framed.

item.title: Iraq warns of terror threat from Syria after US withdrawal
item.description: Iraq's foreign minister warns ISIS fighters could cross from Syria as Baghdad prepares its forces after the US withdrawal.

item.title: 128 GOP lawmakers seek probe into Planned Parenthood funding
item.description: A group of 128 Republican lawmakers is asking the HHS Inspector General to review Planned Parenthood's federal funding for potential fraud.

item.title: House GOP's four-week plan to save its majority
item.description: House GOP Chairwoman Lisa McClain outlines four key topics Republicans will focus on before the November midterms.
